离线 · 无上传 · 浏览器本地完成Offline · no uploads · runs in the browser

CSV 转 WebP——离线、表格按 A4 分页出图CSV to WebP offline — the table as A4 pages

这条链是**三步**，中间真的有一份 PDF：`csv>html` + `html>pdf` + `pdf>webp`（路径基线现读）。第一步只出一张表格——SheetJS 的 `sheet_to_html` 把行与格写成 HTML 标记，**只有内容与结构**：列宽、字号、底色、边框样式都不在里面（读取根本没要单元格样式），公式也是文件里存下的值，不会被重算。第二步由浏览器把这份 HTML 排在 **800 px 版心**里、按 **A4** 逐页渲染，每页作为 **PNG 无损切片**写进 PDF；第三步由 pdf.js 把每页画到白底画布上，`encodeCanvas` 编成 WebP——所以**整条链只量化一次**，质量与目标尺寸这些旋钮只作用在最后那一步。要如实说清的代价有三条，都跟「表格比版心宽/长」有关：一，**宽度没有闸**，超出内容区的右侧列会被裁掉而不是换行，宽表请先拆列；二，**高度有闸**，排版超过 32768 px 时渲染那一步明确报 `errors.renderTooTall`（CSV→PDF 用的是同一道闸），所以超长表要分批；三，这条链的中间 PDF 因为同一道高度闸**排不到几百页**，出图那一步的页数上限在这里其实碰不到，别把它当成长表的保险。产物是图片：格子里的字选不中、不能被程序读回，要交付数据本身请走 CSV→JSON / TXT 那几页。全程只有 storage 权限，不联网。This chain is **three steps** with a real PDF inside: `csv>html` + `html>pdf` + `pdf>webp`, read live from the baseline. Step one emits a single table — SheetJS’s `sheet_to_html` writes rows and cells as markup carrying **content and structure only**: column widths, font sizes, fills and borders are not in it (the reader never asks for cell styles), and formulas are the stored values, never re-evaluated. Step two lets the browser set that HTML into the **800 px measure**, paginate it on **A4** and write each page into the PDF as a **lossless PNG slice**; step three has pdf.js draw every page onto a white canvas and `encodeCanvas` it into WebP — so **the chain quantises exactly once**, and quality or target-size knobs act only on that last step. Three costs must be stated, all about tables being wider or longer than the page. First, **nothing gates width**: columns running past the content box are clipped, not wrapped, so split a wide table first. Second, height is gated: past 32768 px of laid-out page the render step fails with `errors.renderTooTall` (CSV to PDF shares that gate), so a very long table needs splitting. Third, because the same ceiling keeps the intermediate PDF far from hundreds of pages, the image step’s page cap is unreachable here — it is not a safety net for long tables. And the artifact is a picture: cell values cannot be selected or read back by a program, so deliver the data through CSV to JSON or TXT instead. All of it on the storage permission, with no network.

共 3 步，由扩展的路径搜索自动选出，中间产物不落盘。3 steps, chosen by the extension's own path search; intermediate results never touch the disk.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 内容与结构都在：行列、单元格顺序与文字按表格原样进标记再进图Content and structure survive: rows, cells and their order go from the table into markup and from there into the image
  • 整条链只量化一次：中间是 PNG 无损切片，质量与目标尺寸只作用在 WebP 终点One quantisation on the whole chain: the middle is lossless PNG slices, quality and target size act only on the WebP endpoint
  • 按 A4 逐页出图，一页一张 WebP；多页打包成 ZIP，条目按页顺序命名Paginated on A4, one WebP per page; several pages arrive as a ZIP numbered in page order
  • 背景固定白底：表格图不谈透明，边界也不会带半透明残留A fixed white ground: a table picture has no alpha story and keeps no translucent leftovers
  • 一批最多 200 个文件、单个 100 MB，与其他路线共用同一道闸门Up to 200 files per batch and 100 MB each — the same gate every other route shares

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 宽度没有闸：超出约 800 px 版心的右侧列被裁掉而不是换行，宽表请先拆列Nothing gates width: columns past the roughly 800 px measure are clipped, not wrapped — split a wide table first
  • 高度有闸：排版超过 32768 px 时明确报 `errors.renderTooTall`，超长表要分批（CSV→PDF 同一道闸）Height is gated: past 32768 px of laid-out page it fails with `errors.renderTooTall`, so long tables need splitting (CSV to PDF carries the same ceiling)
  • 呈现层不进中间那份 HTML：列宽、字号、底色、边框都按渲染默认样式重画The presentation layer never enters the intermediate HTML: widths, sizes, fills and borders are redrawn with renderer defaults
  • 产物是图片：格子里的字选不中、也不能被程序读回，要数据请走 CSV→JSON / TXTThe artifact is a picture: cell values cannot be selected or read back by a program — take CSV to JSON or TXT for data
  • 没有选页这一步：分页来自排版，页码选择只在源是 PDF 时存在There is no page-range step: pagination comes from layout, and the range control exists only when the source is a PDF

实操提示Working with it

  • 要一份多页文档：CSV→PDF，中间那份 PDF 就是终点、切片无损For a multi-page document: CSV to PDF, where the intermediate PDF becomes the destination
  • 要一页一张且最通用：CSV→JPG 是同一条三步链，终点换成 JPEGFor one page per image with maximum reach: CSV to JPG is the same chain ending in JPEG
  • 要交付数据：CSV→JSON 或 TXT，那里是值而不是画面To deliver data: CSV to JSON or TXT, which hand over values rather than a picture

常见问题Questions people actually ask

我的表有 30 列，转出来右边没了？My table has 30 columns and the right side disappeared?

这是这条链的实际行为：中间那份 HTML 排在约 800 px 版心里，宽度方向没有任何检查，超出的列被裁掉而不是折到下一行。要么先把表拆成两组列，要么改用 CSV→HTML 自己在浏览器里横向滚动，要么走 CSV→PDF 再在阅读器里缩放。That is how this chain behaves: the intermediate HTML is set into a roughly 800 px measure, nothing checks the width, and the overflowing columns are clipped rather than pushed to a second line. Split the columns into two groups, use CSV to HTML and scroll sideways in a browser, or take CSV to PDF and zoom in a reader.

为什么图里的数字在 Excel 里算不了？Why can’t Excel compute with the numbers in the image?

因为产物是位图：格子里的字被画成像素，没有可寻址的单元格。要能继续算，就得交付数据本身——CSV→JSON 或 CSV→TXT 走的是同一份 HTML 之前的值，不经这些渲染步骤。Because the artifact is a bitmap: the cell text is painted, with no addressable cells. To keep computing, deliver data instead — CSV to JSON or TXT works from the values before any of these rendering steps.

长表会不会被切成几百页？Will a long table be sliced into hundreds of pages?

不会走到那一步：排版高度超过 32768 px 时，渲染那一环就会明确报错要求拆短，所以中间那份 PDF 实际排不到几百页——出图那一步的页数上限在这条链上碰不到，别把它当保险。正确做法是分批转换或改交付形式。It never gets that far: past 32768 px of laid-out height the render step fails and asks you to split, so the intermediate PDF cannot actually grow to hundreds of pages — the image step’s page ceiling is unreachable on this chain and should not be treated as a safety net. Split the run, or change what you deliver.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
